name: data-bi
description: Demo de plataforma de datos e-commerce: Postgres + pgvector, ETL multi-fuente, catálogo de métricas certificadas y chatbot con dashboards.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d && pnpm --filter @data-bi/etl run wait-db
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm db:up && pnpm migrate
scripts.setup: pnpm migrate && pnpm gen --scale small && pnpm etl
